label: Market/problem failure
definition: The target problem is not urgent frequent or valuable enough

label: Product-market fit failure
definition: Customers do not adopt retain pay or expand reliably

label: Pricing failure
definition: Price or packaging cannot capture sufficient value

label: Unsustainable unit economics
definition: Contribution economics do not support scalable growth

label: Capital/runway failure
definition: The company cannot finance operations or reach the next milestone

label: Distribution failure
definition: The company lacks a repeatable affordable route to customers

label: Competition/displacement
definition: Competitors platforms or incumbents remove the advantage

label: Team/capability failure
definition: Missing skills leadership turnover or founder conflict materially impair execution

label: Governance failure
definition: Board ownership incentives or controls fail

label: Operations/execution failure
definition: Delivery quality reliability or process cannot scale

label: Timing/macro failure
definition: Market readiness economic conditions or timing prevent adoption

label: Regulatory/legal failure
definition: Law approvals compliance or litigation block viability

label: Technology/product failure
definition: Core technology cannot meet required performance cost or reliability

label: Premature scaling/focus failure
definition: Scope complexity or hiring grows before repeatable evidence

label: Fraud/misconduct
definition: Deception misconduct or control failure causes collapse

label: Unknown/unclear cause
definition: Available evidence does not establish a cause
